stories.dek: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff, speaking with Jim Cramer at Dreamforce, warned AI companies not to repeat social media's harms — and stopped short of calling for a slowdown.
stories.excerpt: At Dreamforce, Marc Benioff told CNBC's Jim Cramer that social-media harms are a cautionary tale for AI. He did not join calls to slow model development.

stories.dek: The SEC on July 27, 2026, sent Congress the 45th Annual Small Business Forum report (release 2026-70), covering the March 9 forum, participant recommendations, and Commission responses.
stories.excerpt: Release 2026-70 is dated July 27, 2026 — not mid-September. The report summarizes the March 9 forum's three sessions and pairs top recommendations with Commission replies.
